title: ID0412058-DC/Si-D/DE-[vjvgSy] Payment Issue
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Solution:
The charging point and then the payment method "Credit Card" are selected on the display - then the message "Please wait" appears and nothing further can be done.
Times of customer calls on March 11: 12:39 PM, 3:56 PM,
6:16 PM
When the customer asked to select the payment method "RFID Card"
instead of "Credit Card," the response was that
after selecting "RFID Card" as requested, the message "Present RFID Card" appeared. Unfortunately, none of the customers had a valid RFID card with them to continue the test. We noticed the following about the OCPP logs:
The 170003980 no longer appears to be connected; no logs are being received. The last status is from March 10 at 5:15 PM. In the logs of 170003981 we keep seeing
“Internal Error” or “Faulted”, nothing more
The ticket was created by innocept mobility GmbH, backend provider and first-level customer support for DG Nexolution Mobility GmbH, the operator of the charging stations, together with Frenger Energie Gb.
